headline: Bank of America Now Accepting Proposals for 2027 Art Conservation Project

headline: Simon Property Group (SPG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases
summary: The latest update for Simon Property Group shows a modest lift in fair value estimates, with the internal price target moving from US$224.42 to US$227.95. That shift aligns with recent Street research, where price targets are clustering higher as analysts refine funds from operations and net operating income assumptions, even while views on risk and entry points remain split. headline: Bank of America (BAC) Signals OCC Penalties Over Anti Money Laundering Deficiencies
summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) disclosed that it may face monetary penalties tied to deficiencies in its anti money laundering program. The bank indicated that a resolution with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, or OCC, could be near. This disclosure marks a change from earlier statements that suggested any regulatory outcome was not expected to have a material financial impact.
